channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Docherty talks qualifying for Open Championship, surviving car accident
item.description: Alistair Docherty won the 119 Visa Argentina Open last week to qualify for the 2026 The Open Championship. Docherty earned a one-stroke victory over Chris Korte and S.Y. Noh for his first Korn Ferry Tour title by birdying the final hole of the tournament.

item.title: Why is Scottie Scheffler so good at Bay Hill? It might be because of this shot
item.description: Explained in detail a couple weeks ago by fellow pro Ryan Gerard, Scheffler has mastered the off-speed shot that doesn't sacrifice height or spin.

item.title: John Daly II talks 2026 Puerto Rico Open, end of collegiate career
item.description: John Daly II spoke with Golf Channel ahead of the 2026 Puerto Rico Open. Daly II, who followed his father's footsteps to attend the University of Arkansas, is set to graduate this spring.

item.title: European players react to Donald captaincy news at API
item.description: Luke Donald was named one of two captains of the 2027 European Ryder Cup team on Wednesday. Shane Lowry and Justin Rose shared their thoughts on the news with Golf Channel's Todd Lewis ahead of the 2026 Arnold Palmer Invitational.

item.title: 'European tour can only do so much to accommodate': McIlroy on Rahm's Ryder Cup eligibility
item.description: Rory McIlroy believes the deal that grants conditional release for players to compete on both the DP World Tour and LIV Golf is softer than the penalty Brooks Koepka took to rejoin the PGA Tour.

item.title: Strengthened by adversity, Daniel Bennett unfazed entering PGA Tour debut
item.description: The Texas sophomore arrives for his PGA Tour debut at Bay Hill ready to see how he stacks up against the best players in the world, while knowing he's overcome far bigger challenges.

item.title: Pavan released from hospital after suffering serious injuries from elevator accident
item.description: DP World Tour player Andrea Pavan has been released from a South African hospital after suffering severe shoulder damage and fractures to several vertebrae, among other injuries. He had emergency surgery on his right shoulder and back last Wednesday night.

item.title: Who should the U.S. look at for Ryder Cup captain in 2027?
item.description: Golf Channel's Brandel Chamblee believes the United States next Ryder Cup captain will need to be extraordinary at understanding data, group dynamics and team building. Chamblee floated the name Justin Leonard as someone to consider, and said 2027 might not be the right time for Tiger Woods to lead the American team.

item.title: McIlroy remains on side of European tour amid conflict with Rahm's Ryder Cup eligibility
item.description: Rory McIlroy spoke about the ongoing eligibility situation with Europe's Ryder Cup team after his round at Bay Hill Club on Wednesday. McIlroy believes two extra events on the European tour to retain membership - and stay eligible for the 2027 Ryder Cup - "isn’t a heavy lift" and a considerably lighter accommodation than what the PGA Tour enacted earlier this year with its Returning Member Program.

item.title: NCAA highlights: 2026 Darius Rucker Intercollegiate, Round 3
item.description: Farah O'Keefe and the Texas Longhorns captured the individual and team from the Darius Rucker Intercollegiate at Long Cove Club in Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, on Wednesday afternoon.
